cta_text.description: Fix cycle 3 item 4: the ONE CTA button text for this page. Must be exactly one of this schema's top-level allowed_cta_texts, with {short_name} filled in with the product's actual short_name (fix cycle 4 item 3) . The renderer reuses it verbatim in the hero and the repeat CTA -- choose it once here, never repeat/vary it elsewhere.

cta_url.description: The CTA's destination URL, reused everywhere cta_text is.

hero.description: product name, one-line promise from the ad angle, price, financing line, hero image.

promise.description: One-line promise from the ad angle. Keep it descriptive, not a numeric claim -- put any number/price/percent in price_line or financing_line instead.

price_line.description: e.g. text: '$8,250'. Only add a compare-at/'was $X' figure if facts_pack.product.compare_at_price is non-null. Must carry the product's price claim_id.

financing_line.description: text: 'Financing available' when facts_pack.product.financing.lender is null (no lender name, no monthly figure); otherwise may name the lender and monthly figure from facts_pack.product.financing.

proof_bullets.description: Exactly 3 bullets, each one verified claim with a short label and a one-line explanation, chosen to match the ad's angle. Fix cycle 3 item 3: at least 3 of them must be product-benefit claim_ids -- what the sauna does or is built with (e.g. medical-grade red light therapy, full-spectrum near/mid/far infrared, US-owned company, free shipping, limited lifetime warranty) -- not price, shipping-policy, warranty-terms, or returns-policy; the gate fails the page otherwise.

angle_section.description: 1 H2 + 2-4 short paragraphs (or an image/text pair) expanding what the ad said.

attributed_to_customer.description: True only if this paragraph states a number that comes solely from the ad speaker's own estimate/hedge (ad_brief.speaker_experience), phrased as her own words, never as a brand fact and never carrying a claim_id. Never true anywhere else in this schema (never on a heading, proof_bullets, or specs_table row).

trust_strip.description: warranty, shipping/delivery, returns, review count+rating -- from verified_claims only.

detail_images.description: 1-2 additional detail shots from the asset library.
